description: This file defines the RouteProvider class in Drupal, responsible for managing route data, including fetching, caching, and resolving routes from the database and path patterns.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Routing\RouteProvider
classes.description: Provides route management, including fetching, caching, and pattern matching for Drupal routes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteProvider with dependencies such as database connection, cache, path processor, and language manager.

methods.name: getRouteCollectionForRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of routes that may match the given request, utilizing cache for performance.

methods.name: getRouteByName
methods.description: Fetches a route object by its name, resolving aliases and handling deprecation warnings.

methods.name: preLoadRoutes
methods.description: Preloads route data for given route names into cache to optimize subsequent lookups.

methods.name: getRoutesByNames
methods.description: Returns route objects for a list of route names, loading from cache or database as needed.

methods.name: getCandidateOutlines
methods.description: Generates possible route pattern outlines that could match a given path.

methods.name: getRoutesByPattern
methods.description: Retrieves routes matching a specific pattern outline.

methods.name: getRoutesByPath
methods.description: Fetches routes from the database that match a specific path outline.

methods.name: routeProviderRouteCompare
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting routes by fit and name.

methods.name: getAllRoutes
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all routes stored in the database.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears cached routes and triggers cache invalidation.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns events this class subscribes to, notably to reset cache after routing is finished.

methods.name: addExtraCacheKeyPart
methods.description: Adds additional parts to the cache key for route cache differentiation.

methods.name: getRouteCollectionCacheId
methods.description: Generates a cache ID for route collection based on request and context.

methods.name: getQueryParametersCacheIdPart
methods.description: Creates a cache key part based on normalized query parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentLanguageCacheIdPart
methods.description: Creates a cache key part based on the current language.

methods.name: getRouteAliases
methods.description: Retrieves route aliases for a given route name.
